meta.note: Front door for phone bookings (Twilio) — parity-matched against crea-01's WhatsApp guards: blocklist, the 3-day quiet period after a human handoff, and call-attempt flood protection all apply here too (checked once per call, at the first turn — not per Gather turn, since one legitimate booking call is many turns). Verifies the request is really from Twilio (HMAC over CREA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL + params using CREA_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN — the one public endpoint in CREA, unlike WAHA which never needs one). First turn: fixed greeting, no LLM call. Every turn after: routes through the SAME creaaiassistant brain WhatsApp uses (channel:'voice'), keyed by caller number so a customer who calls and later texts shares one brief. Reply text comes back via the state store (Save Reply for Caller in crea-02b), not the Execute Workflow return value — matches how every other cross-workflow handoff in CREA works. Ends the call with <Hangup/> once confirmed, handed to a human, or flood-blocked; otherwise re-Gathers for the next turn.
